function.arguments: {"message":"For an acquisition‑related ownership transfer, our support team will need proof that the acquisition is genuine. Typically this includes public announcements, legal documentation (e.g., merger agreements), or a confirmation from a contact at the acquired company. arguments.message: For an acquisition‑related ownership transfer, our support team will need proof that the acquisition is genuine. Typically this includes public announcements, legal documentation (e.g., merger agreements), or a confirmation from a contact at the acquired company. Once we have that evidence, a reviewer will verify the new contact’s authority to act on behalf of the acquiring company before completing the transfer. Please have the acquiring company’s representative reach out to support with the relevant documents.
